summary: Verified V2 Unified Exercise Library is now the DEFAULT for coaches. Mobile: tapping LIBRARY bottom tab routes to /library and renders V2 (header 'EXERCISE CONTENT', search bar 'Search exercises, tags, equipment…', all 10 filter chips ALL/WARM-UP/MOBILITY/STRENGTH/CARDIO/REHAB/COOLDOWN/TOMORROW/MISSING/APPROVED, V2 testIDs new-exercise + scan-todos, exercise rows rendered incl. Bulgarian Split Squat / Walking Lunges / Goblet Squat / World's Greatest Stretch / Push-Up / Zone 2 Walk / Dumbbell Row / Hip Hinge / Plank / Band Pull-Apart / Dead Bug / Overhead Press / 90/90 Hip Rotation / Kettlebell Swing …). NO 'OPEN V2' button anywhere on the default screen. NO 'migrated to Unified Exercise Content' banner. NO LEGACY V1 banner. Desktop: left sidebar 'Library' click routes to /library and renders the same V2 screen; sidebar contains no legacy library link. Legacy fallback /(coach)/library-legacy still renders V1 with yellow 'Legacy V1 view · read-only fallback' banner and its own OPEN V2 button; it is hidden from the mobile tab bar (tab labels observed: CLIENTS, APPROVALS, LIBRARY, CONTENT, MESSAGES, PROFILE — no LEGACY). Regression tabs (APPROVALS/CLIENTS/MESSAGES/PROFILE) all navigate. Opening 'Bulgarian Split Squat' from V2 shows detail sheet with demo images (male/female), required positions, coaching points, alternatives, and approval controls. Zero page errors during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: library.tsx is a one-liner re-export from '@/app/coach/exercise-content' — clean, single source of truth.
(coach)/_layout.tsx correctly registers <Tabs.Screen name='library-legacy' options={ href: null } /> so the legacy route is a valid Expo Router destination but is hidden from the bottom tab bar.
library-legacy.tsx retains a working 'OPEN V2' escape hatch (testID lib-legacy-goto-v2) and a yellow LEGACY banner, matching the spec.
No breaking changes to exercise-content.tsx surface (testIDs new-exercise, scan-todos, gen-*, slot-chip-*, prompt-* all still present).
